title: Monotonic Calibration Head v5 Provenance Sidecar
description: Schema for the v5 per-bucket monotonic calibration head emitted by tools/local_labels/fit_monotonic_calibration_head_v5.py. Records the head's full provenance: feature_schema (the 6 canonical features + monotonic constraint signs), model_class_per_bucket, monotonic_constraints_by_feature (only on used features), fold_assignments (deterministic stratified round-robin, seed=20260527), selected_hyperparameters, dependency_versions (flat package -> version map), training_cell_ids, source_commit (commit containing the fitter source), dependency_availability (full hierarchy probe), composite_score_formula (verbatim from the goal tracker's model-class hierarchy row), and cohort_scope (per-cell admitted + skipped lists with typed reasons).

calibration_head_version.description: Always 5 for this schema. v1/v2/v3/v4 use their own schemas.

source_commit.description: Git HEAD at emission time. MUST point at a commit that contains the fitter source so the artifact is reproducible (the BL-20260527-two-commit-landing-source-commit-pinning discipline).

dependency_availability.description: Structured dependency probe: { class_name: { available: bool, version: str|null, import_path: str, package: str } } for each candidate class in the registered hierarchy.

dependency_versions.description: Flat package -> version map. NULL value means the package is not importable on this host. Required v5 provenance per the goal tracker.

composite_score_formula.description: Verbatim composite-score formula. Constants pinned so any drift fails closed.

canonical_feature_names.description: The 6 canonical pre-calibration feature names in canonical order.

monotonic_constraints_by_feature.description: Pinned sign table per the goal tracker's monotonic constraint sign row. Drift on any feature's sign fails closed.

fit_status.description: Fit-time outcome. 'empty_cohort_no_admitted_cells' is the schema-valid empty-fit marker when zero cells admit (e.g., all cells fail the canonical_pre_calibration_features_absent gate). 'indeterminate_dependencies_absent' is the schema-valid marker when no registered model class (sklearn IR, pygam GAM, lightgbm GBM, xgboost) is importable on the host.

status.description: Coarse at-a-glance fit outcome: 'ok' when the head was fit (fit_status=='ok'), else 'indeterminate_insufficient_data' (collapses the empty-cohort and dependencies-absent fit_status arms). Optional for backward compatibility with heads emitted before this field was added; emitted by fit_monotonic_calibration_head_v5.py going forward.

model_class_per_bucket.description: Per-(arch/family_bucket) key -> class name (e.g. 'isotonic_regression_on_frozen_projection'). When the bucket falls back to pooled fit, the class name appends '__pooled_fallback_with_one_hot' per the per-bucket minimum-N rule.

monotonic_constraints_by_feature.description: Per-bucket constraint table. Keys are bucket keys; values are dicts of feature -> sign for ONLY the used features (per the goal tracker's monotonic constraint sign row's 'only on used_features' invariant). Pooled-fallback buckets include 'family_bucket_one_hot' alongside the base projection features.

fold_assignments.description: Per-cell-identity -> fold-index map. Cell identities serialized as repr(list) string keys.

fold_construction.description: Records the fold-construction decision: stratified_round_robin or non_stratified_fallback, with seed=20260527 and per-stratum sizes.

selected_hyperparameters.description: Per-class selected hyperparameters (e.g., increasing=True + out_of_bounds=clip + projection_weights + projection_features for the IR-on-projection class).

selected_class.description: The winning class metadata: name, parameter_count, primary/secondary/tertiary CV scores, selection_reason.

training_cell_ids.description: Per-bucket list of cell identities used to fit that bucket's head. Required for reproducibility.

per_bucket_provenance.description: Per-bucket kind + n_train + training_cell_ids + (when kind=pooled_fallback) pooled_bias. Top-level pooled_used_features lists the expanded feature surface including family_bucket_one_hot when any pooled fallback fired.

allOf.description: Per-bucket per_bucket-kind buckets MUST have n_train >= 8 per the per-bucket minimum-N rule. A synthetic head with n_train=5 and kind=per_bucket fails this conditional.
